scripts.build:hooks: npm run build:addon:hooks && npm run build:hooks --workspace typose
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package --workspace typose
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p app/shared && tsc --noEmit -p app/main && tsc --noEmit -p app/preload && tsc --noEmit -p app/core-host && tsc --noEmit -p app/renderer && tsc --noEmit -p e2e
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && vitest run && node --test e2e/netlog-assert.test.mjs e2e/perf/frames.test.mjs e2e/perf/cold.test.mjs
scripts.test:hooks: npm run build:addon:hooks && cargo test --locked --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml --workspace --features typose-node/test-hooks && vitest run --mode test-hooks
scripts.e2e: npm run build:hooks && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:smoke: npm run e2e -- shell.e2e chrome.e2e open.e2e rendered.e2e csv-demo.e2e folder-sidebar-demo.e2e link-peek-demo.e2e packaged.e2e netlog.e2e
